product_metadata.title: Homevolts Digital Temperature Control Kettle 1.7L Stainless Boil Dry Protection Tea Kettle with Strix
features: Precise Temperature Control Water Kettle: Choose from 4 preset temperatures to get the best, most flavorful tea, coffee or simply boil cooking water.
Built from Food Safe Materials: Made of stainless steel and BPA-free, enables the kettle boils water free of contaminants; suitable to prepare infant meals.
Fast Boiling Electric Kettle: 1500W high power can shorten boiling time, perfect for office and household. MAX marks help to notice not fill water over and prevent overflowing.
Easy and Secure Handling: Safely control the cordless Electric kettle with the neatly arranged touch panel integrated into the thermally insulated handle.
Single water gauge in handle help you easy to see the water level
